channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday competitions 2026 (UK)
channel.description: UK competitions and prize draws tied to Black Friday (Friday 27 November 2026), Black Week and Cyber Monday (30 November), each checked on the organiser's own page. Many run only for a few days around Black Friday, so check the closing date. Free to enter unless marked – where buying gives an entry, we only list draws with a free entry route.

item.title: BOLIA Black Week competition: win your favourite design – BOLIA A/S
item.description: Prize: The most expensive design on your favourites list, worth up to £6,800. Deadline: November 19, 2026. Join MyBOLIA (free), create a favourites list called BW26 and save the designs you dream of. 18+, UK residents. Closes 19 November 2026

item.title: KILLSTAR Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a £1,000 gift card – KILLSTAR (Draco Distribution Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One £1,000 KILLSTAR gift card for one UK winner (valid 6 months). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Free: sign up for KILLSTAR emails via an official KILLSTAR sign-up form, or email giveaway@killstar.com with the subject "Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway" and your full name. Optional SMS opt-in gives one bonus entry. UK residents 18+. Closes 11:59 pm GMT on 22 November 2026

item.title: Flower & White Black Friday VIP giveaway: £500 in vouchers – Flower & White
item.description: Prize: £250 Secret Escapes voucher + £250 Love2shop voucher (£500 total), one winner. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Join the Black Friday VIP list via the sign-up form on the page. Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 2 December 2026; page says entries until 6 December 2026

item.title: Cartridge People Black Colourful Friday free daily prize draw – The Cartridge People Ltd
item.description: Prize: Seven daily prizes 23–29 Nov, incl. a Samsung Q7F 55" 4K TV, Shark Freestyle Max vacuum, Ninja coffee machine, Lenovo tablet, Cricut Explore 4 and Samsung Odyssey monitor + Brother scanner. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Free entry form on the Cartridge People Black Friday promotion page, once per day from 23 to 29 November 2026 (each day closes 23:59 GMT). No purchase necessary; orders also give an automatic entry. UK & Channel Islands residents 18+
